rv.q: It's a joy to have Dame Edna Everage back on Broadway, regardless of the indignities she's forced to suffer in 'All About Me.'
Not since Felix Ungar and Oscar Madison moved in together has Broadway had such an odd couple on the boards.
Seen side by side, in a production that brings to mind a desperately assembled television variety show from the 1970s, these two headliners clash like polka dots paired with plaid.
The show then ends with a Merman
It's just this kind of recycled material that makes "All About Me" all about meh.
It tries to be a two-star show starring Michael Feinstein and Dame Edna Everage, but ends up being two one-star shows.
